newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares ease but no Iraq impact seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares ease but no Iraq impact seen.

text.p: Russian shares eased on Tuesday but dealers said the U.S. attack on Iraq had no significant impact on the market.
"It seems that the market is not so happy with the comments and the whole event but so far there is no significant impact, said Alexander Bubnovsky, head of sales at Alfa-Capital.
Volume on the Russian Trading System was $12.93 million and the RTS-21 index of leading stocks fell 0.87 percent to 183.90.
Bubnovsky said prices initially rose, fell around midday and rose again towards the close.
"Some orders came from the United States and that supported the market," he said. "Tomorrow, I think the market will probably be a little stronger."
Another dealer said the fall was about equivalent to Monday's rise. "It was a correction of prices," he said.
"If it had been connected to the events in Iraq, the fall would have been deeper."
Unified Energy System fell to $0.082 from $0.0836 and Irkustekenergo eased to 10.9 cents from 11 cents.
